semantics.clock: All state updates occur on the positive edge of clk only.
semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous reset takes priority and loads q=5'b00001 on each rising edge with reset=1.
semantics.initialization: No power-up value is specified before a sampled reset; no initial block or autonomous recovery is required.
semantics.transition: With reset=0: next q[4]=old q[0], next q[3]=old q[4], next q[2]=old q[3] XOR old q[0], next q[1]=old q[2], next q[0]=old q[1].
semantics.tap_numbering: Positions 5 and 3 are one-based and correspond to vector indices 4 and 2.
semantics.period: From reset seed 1, traverse all 31 nonzero 5-bit states and then return to 1.
semantics.between_edges: q holds its state, including across reset transitions without a positive clock edge.

numeric.arithmetic: Bitwise XOR over GF(2); logical right shift with zero insertion before feedback XOR at indices 4 and 2.
numeric.rounding_overflow: Not applicable: all transitions are exact bit operations within 5 bits.

verification.sequence: Check every rising-edge state over two full 31-cycle periods; independently require all 31 nonzero states distinct and return to seed at exactly step 31.
verification.reset: Check synchronous-only reset changes, priority at positive edges, repeated held reset, and reset during sequence followed by restart.
verification.stability: Check falling-edge and between-edge state stability.
verification.tools: Icarus SystemVerilog compile with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top, matching vvp, finite external and testbench timeouts.
